name: Talismans
look: Talisman barrier from cultivation fantasy. Six yellow paper talismans painted with red glyphs orbit the character, joined to each other by thin lines of golden light forming a hexagon.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the six talismans in their hexagon alone, the golden lines between them, no glow

parts.name: TALISMAN
parts.text: one paper talisman alone, upright, its red glyph clear
forms: burning, its lower half in flames
burnt to a curl of ash

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: burning paper flecks, golden sparks, a small flame

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the golden lines and talismans, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the talismans flick out one by one from the character's hand and take their places in the ring, the light lines joining them
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the talismans orbit slowly and flutter, the light lines between them glowing; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the talisman on that side flares and burns up in a puff of fire, the light lines flicker but hold

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the remaining talismans catch fire one after another and burn to drifting ash
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
